First $800 with 8500 profit then 93,500 profit. So once I asked to withdraw he said I needed to pay a $1000 signal fee. I dont know if its real or a scam but imo its seems to me to not be legit. Chat box did work and customer support did email but I they told was the same thing Castro dernell told me which was to pay for the signal fee
